Financial leaders tiptoe around Beijing’s asset scrutiny, hail Hong Kong’s wealth boom
items.summary: Global financial leaders who gathered in Hong Kong this week largely sidestepped Beijing’s offshore trust tax crackdown, a lingering near-term hurdle for the city’s otherwise expanding wealth management industry.

items.title: Cornell faculty vote ‘no confidence’ in university leadership after alleged gang rape

items.title: An OPP officer struck and killed a pedestrian. Shortly after that, she was promoted.
items.summary: An Ontario mom is speaking out two years after an OPP officer driving the speeding vehicle that struck and killed her 25-year-old son was promoted shortly after the collision.

items.title: Northern, remote RCMP detachments chronically and critically understaffed: internal report
items.summary: Northern and isolated RCMP detachments have become "chronically and at times critically" understaffed, according to an internal evaluation report — the latest document pointing to retention and recruitment issues within the storied organization.
